text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Once again... Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
""Happy New Year!" "Happy New Year!" 
"Happy New Year!""

From the tablet I had lent her, the 
familiar voices of the three girls could 
be heard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It has not been all that long since we 
last met, everyone... but I am glad to see 
you are all doing well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san... Is it still early in the 
morning over "there"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But please don't worry about it. In 
Germany, life starts early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Rose-san. What about your 
location...?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This year's party is even noisier than 
usual. Thus, I came out to the mountain 
behind the estate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking what a sharply dressed 
outfit that was, but now I see. Thank you 
for your hard work right at the start of 
the new year, Your Majesty."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It's hardly what I'd call a hardship. 
Besides, speaking of outfits, you're the 
one who...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh—it's the most rational attire for 
healing body and mind to prepare for 
battle, right?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"And where might that place be? Don't tell 
me... it's your parents' home?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm at a rental house. My family home is 
noisy around New Year's. It's partly for 
this call, but more importantly, today is 
the main tournament for the New Year 
Online Shogi Cup—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Well, anyway. Enough about me. How about 
you, Pisa? Is that the Trainer's office 
you're in?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was thinking it would be nice to 
spend a relaxing New Year's together with 
you, Trainer.

I smile back at her wink. In truth, we 
hadn't done a single thing that could 
actually be called training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"So everyone without exception is on 
vacation. Well... last month truly lived 
up to the name of December, the month when 
even teachers run."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, quite the humble way to put it. It 
has been a busy—nay, a glorious month!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Flash-san's 1st place in the Pre-OP, 
Rose's 1st place in the GⅠ, Pisa's Hopeful 
Stakes, and...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And, Ruler-san's debut race victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one of them achieved solid 
results, didn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to that, I was blessed with 
numerous passionate words from my 
relatives right at the start of the new 
year.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just claiming a long-sought G1 
victory; the rising anticipation for the 
Classic series seemed to have everyone 
buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Claim the pinnacle of this generation—that 
is my charge.

That doesn't just apply to the House of 
Roses.

Across every corner of the racing world, 
attention toward this generation was 
steadily rising.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Reach the pinnacle of this generation"—is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the pinnacle, it has to 
be... the second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And there, we will gather together, 
infinitely stronger than we are now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Umamusume races are meant to inspire 
emotion and hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
High-level battles on the grandest stages 
stir the soul even more deeply, forging 
strong, unyielding bonds between people's 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want to see it 
through. I want to create a great circle 
among the stands."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Getting ahead of yourself before the 
Classic campaign even begins, aren't you? 
But—I don't dislike it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, sorry to say, but victory is 
mine. You are all mere pawns, and I rule 
this entire race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's the race everyone dreams of winning— 
that is the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I haven't been able to come 
up with a better present for my parents 
either.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, is that a declaration of war? Right 
at the start of the New Year, you're full 
of fighting spirit, Flash-san."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, I merely shared accurate 
information with total honesty."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“—Regardless, what we must do remains 
unchanged.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To earnestly, single-mindedly hone one's 
legs for the sake of one's ideals.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And let us make the upcoming "Japanese 
Derby" the most glorious battle in 
history.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us continue moving forward 
together. Hand in hand, as one.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Heading toward the Nippon Derby.

Inspiring each other, shining together— 
the further this circle of peers moved 
toward the future, the more new hope it 
gave birth to.

When she talked about wanting to pass that 
on, I never imagined it would generate 
such undeniable strength.

Just how much foresight did Victoire Pisa 
have when she talked about this dream back 
then...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, calling it a "vision" makes it sound 
way more grandiose than what I had in 
mind.

After that phone call, I took a walk 
toward the town bustling with New Year 
celebrations.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I had simply moved forward into the future 
one step beyond what I wished for back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Surely—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If it is us, we can create a grand, 
brilliant sense of unity and excitement.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We can definitely do it. With how we are 
right now, even miraculous things like 
that are possible.

A warm smile naturally came to my face at 
her gentle yet passionate feelings.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time will be even bigger—
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's do our best together.
Yeah. Let's do our best together.

text_block_list.text:
"As the next major milestone to reach, we 
made a promise toward that dream."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Look, Trainer. It's a lion 
dance.

When we arrived at the shrine, a lion 
dance was just being performed as part of 
the New Year's festivities.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they have amazake over there. And that 
long line... must be for the lucky charms.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"The lion dance, sweet amazake, and the 
talisman counter. Fufu, they're all 
wonderful, aren't they?"
choice_data_list: Watch the lion dance a bit longer
Line up at the lucky charm counter

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You're right♪ Since we were lucky enough 
to see it, let's stay just a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a lovely dance...♪
I watched the lion dance for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...? Your movements became rather stiff 
all of a sudden. I wonder what's the 
matter?

Shortly after, curious about the lion 
dance that had retreated to the back, I 
quietly followed it with her.

text_block_list.name: Lion Dance Performer A
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow... I seemed to have thrown out my 
back while dancing. Whatever shall I do?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, would it be all right if I 
performed a dance?"

text_block_list.name: Lion Dance Performer A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems like it'll require some 
bracing strength, but... I am an 
Umamusume, after all. I grasped the 
movements earlier as well.
And so――

text_block_list.name: Visiting Child
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Mr. Lion Dance! Please chomp on 
me!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...*chomp*

text_block_list.name: Visiting Child
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. That was a wonderful experience.

Victoire Pisa appeared to be thoroughly 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today was a wonderful New Year's Day. I 
got to talk with everyone, and even go out 
with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how lovely♪ I was actually feeling a 
little chilly. Let's partake."

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Amazake, right? ...Ah, I'm sorry, there's 
only one serving left.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, in that case, Trainer— please give 
this to that person."

"...Refusing would just lead us in circles 
anyway. So, let me make a proposal."
choice_data_list: Could I have another glass, please?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Halves... I hadn't thought of that. Thank 
you very much.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it's so warm. It's delicious, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today was a wonderful New Year's Day. I 
got to talk with everyone, and even go out 
with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That's true, they might end up running 
out.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hehe. The truth is, I saw 
something earlier that I found myself 
wanting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, it's a lion dance puppet.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes, I bring refreshments to the 
junior club I used to attend, and I 
thought they'd be happy if I wore it when 
I visit."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: What do you think? *munch munch*... Fufu♪

New Year's with Victoire Pisa passed by in 
a wonderfully peaceful manner.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today was a wonderful New Year's Day. I 
got to talk with everyone, and even go out 
with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best for another year, 
Trainer-san.

"Concluding a successful year with new 
goals in mind--"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa, you are—

And so, a new year began, leading into the 
Classic campaign.
